## Which 1993 feature is this?

The clone targets the 1993 *Warlords II* floppy. New content should
either:

- (a) exist in the 1993 game but not yet in this clone, or
- (b) be invisible quality-of-life that doesn't change the rules.

If (a), link the manual page, the floppy file, or a screenshot. If
(b), explain why a player would notice and thank you.

Reference materials:

- Manual: `docs/original-reference.md` (if excerpted) or the 1993
  manual PDF.
- Asset location in the 1993 floppy: `msdos_Warlords_II_1993/...`
  (Internet Archive mirror).
- Existing 1993-as-backdrop crops: `public/assets/sprites/original/`.

## What's the user-visible change?

One or two sentences on what the player will see differently.

## What's the implementation sketch?

A short paragraph or bullet list. It's OK to be rough. The maintainer
will turn it into a phase plan.

## Out of scope for this feature

Anything you want to explicitly NOT include (e.g. "no multiplayer",
"no ranged archer rework — that's its own issue").

## Willing to do the work?

- [ ] Yes, I'll open a PR
- [ ] Yes, but I want a phase plan first
- [ ] No, just filing the idea for someone else
